'''House Ituralde''' is a noble house in [[Arad Doman]]. 

==History==
[[Rodel Ituralde]] is [[High Seat]] of House Ituralde. Before Rodel Ituralde, House Ituralde did not exist.{{ref/book|10|Prologue}} King [[Alsalam]] raised Lord Rodel Ituralde, his personal friend, to High Seat of House Ituralde and General of Arad Doman.
